title: Usage policy of an omnisense provider
description: A provider's rate limits, the rights its terms give, what every request must carry, and where this was read. Omnisense\Contracts\Policy\UsagePolicy::fromArray() reads it; a site may tighten it, never loosen it.

rateLimits.description: null: nobody knows them; []: the terms set none. Every limit counts: the strictest wins.

concurrency.description: The most requests the provider takes in flight at once (IGDB: 8); null or absent: not said. Declared and exported; PolicyGuard does not enforce it (a PHP process makes one request at a time). A site may lower it, not raise it.

plans.description: The plans the provider publishes limits for (Free, Pro, S1...). The policy's own rateLimits and concurrency must be the default plan's, where it names them. The factory's "plan" option picks one (UsagePolicy::forPlan()): its rateLimits and concurrency replace the policy's, its source and verifiedAt become the provenance's policy and verifiedAt; rights, requirements and terms stay the provider's. A site may then only tighten it.

default.description: The plan that applies when the site names none: the free or most restrictive one. It must be among the plans.

plan.description: The plan a policy runs under, written by UsagePolicy::forPlan() (a site's effective policy, an export of it); a declaration leaves it out. Never beside plans.

openSourceRequired.description: null: the terms do not say, or nobody read them.

licence.description: The data's licence, as SPDX names it where it can.

retention.description: How long the terms let a site keep the data at all (a stored copy, a database row), unlike caching.maxTtl (how long an answer may be served again). null or absent: the terms set none, or nobody read one. A site may shorten it, never lengthen it nor change what it covers.

covers.description: What it applies to, as the terms say it.

pattern.description: A PCRE, delimiters included, the User-Agent must match.

source.description: Where the provider publishes the plan's limits.

every.description: The windows it spans: {"window": "minute", "every": 5} is 5 minutes.

scope.description: What it counts per: the application, each key, each client address, each user, or each resource of the kind "per" names. A call that names no client address or user counts in a shared bucket; one that names no resource is refused (ResourceNotNamed).

per.description: With the scope "resource" only: the kind of resource each one counts apart ("parcel", "envelope", "zone"); the provider names the one a call is about (PolicyGuard::call()'s context "resource").

operations.description: The family's operations it counts (its contract methods: "journeys", "departures"); empty: every one.

unit.description: What max counts: the provider's HTTP requests (the default, as RateLimit-Policy's quota unit), content bytes (the draft's other unit), or the provider's own units - characters (translation APIs), quota units (YouTube), points (Twitch, GitHub GraphQL).

cost.description: What one call of an operation consumes, in the unit, by operation; 1 for an operation not named, 0 for a free one; null or absent: each costs 1. A cost only the call knows (characters translated) is reported by the provider (PolicyGuard::call()'s amounts).
